title: Parallel past-sequence transfer
instructions: Apply the same timeline method to a new situation.

parts.prompt: By the time the rescue van reached the school, staff ___ the injured bird in a ventilated box.

choice_rationales.A: Had placed marks the completed action before the van's later past arrival.
choice_rationales.B: Present perfect cannot use the van's finished past arrival as a present reference point.
choice_rationales.C: Present continuous contradicts the past timeline and completed placement.
choice_rationales.D: Future form would place the action after now rather than before the van arrived.

parts.hint: By the time identifies a later past event; find what staff had completed first.
parts.correct_explanation: Staff completed the placement before the rescue van arrived, so past perfect expresses the order.
